entry.title: Post-ICLR Recovery
entry.content:
Over the past month I’ve been grinding an ICLR manuscript, a mixture of editing the paper + running more checks from mid-August through late-September. Also unfortuantely my PI was on an instrument mission and one of my thesis committee members was on paternity leave, so it’s been pretty tough. Luckily just submitted the manuscript last Friday, and looking back I don’t know how I managed to watch 4 CDramas (120 ep) in that time frame (thats around 4 ep per day).

List of CDramas in Order

  • 天才，女友 (Genius Girlfriend): 田曦薇 (Tian Xi Wei)
  • 逐玉 (Pursuit of Jade): 田曦薇 (Tian Xi Wei), 张凌赫 (Zhang Ling He)
  • 云之羽 (My Journey to You): 张凌赫 (Zhang Ling He), 卢昱晓 (Lu Yu Xiao)
  • 轧戏 (Love Between Lines): 卢昱晓 (Lu Yu Xiao)

As you can tell, the way I select the next CDrama is pretty evident. But, I’ll probably break that pattern as the next drama I’m planning to watch is 苍兰诀番外 (Love Between Fairy and Devil). Although, there will be lots of familiar faces (Esther Yu, Zhang Ling He).

And as usual, I’ve been keeping up with my Japanese reading, now solid 1/3 way into 君のいる町, and picked up volume 3 of 義妹生活. Also tried out the new BanG Dream! Our Notes game, and honestly not too impressed, but maybe I’ll be using it as a source to practice some Japanese for the new band stories.

As for gaming, always have the typical late-night val with the homies, and C0R1 Vesna obtained in Genshin (unfortuantely, not enough to Dire this Stygian).

And finally have some time to polish some old videos and upload them: my Japan trips, FAN EXPO Boston recap.

Looking forward, things look pretty busy too, at least until my oral presentation (yikes!) on coronal bfield inversions at AGU in early December, which i haven’t started yet… Spent the week looking at how to add Q, U, V spectropolarimetric measurements into my pipeline, and realized that I don’t understand how the saturated Hanle effect works. Then I ended up mostly reading up on atomic alignment, spin precessions, and a bunch of atomic bookkeeping needed. Probably will start implementing the LUTs next week.

December + January looking fun though: it’ll be AGU in SF, meet up with friends, maybe talk to some AI/ML startups there. Then after that I’ll be able to enjoy a nice winter break with family, and a Japan trip in early January!
